description: Source code for the ShowActivity class in an Android application, which displays details about an activity based on its ComponentName and ActivityInfo.

classes.name: ShowActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays detailed information about another activity, including its icon, label, process, permissions, and launch mode.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves activity info from the intent, and populates UI elements with activity details.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onResume method, currently only calls the superclass implementation.
